injuries.description: changes in the left frontal, left parietal and left temporal regions of the brain "suggestive of cerebral infarction secondary to trauma or cerebral contusion"
injuries.body_part: left frontal, left parietal and left temporal regions of the brain
source: a brain scan was performed which revealed changes in the left frontal, left parietal and left temporal regions of the brain. These it is said are "suggestive of cerebral infarction secondary to trauma or cerebral contusion"

manifestations.description: deeply unconscious and remained unconscious for ten days
"a severe specific memory impairment" making it very much more difficult for him to learn new material and to remember anything
dysphasia: an inability to find the right word and to express the thoughts that he is trying to express
anger, becoming cross and on occasions actually violent
impairment of intellectual function and memory

treatments_received: emergency burr hole exploration of the skull
a brain scan (revealed changes in the left frontal, left parietal and left temporal regions of the brain)

losses.description: He has now lost his job as a teacher; he resigned on grounds of ill health with effect from 1st February 1984.
No one asks him to preach now and he has few friends; he has lost involvement at his church where he worked as a lay-preacher.
His wife has gone through a very difficult period; they are physically separated and his marriage may well be at an end.
Underlying mental and personality consequences with anger, frustration and on occasions actual violence; not the same man as before the accident.
The wife was forced to give up her own work to look after the plaintiff and employed a substitute to assist for some considerable period.
